reviews.concise_rationale: The crop visibly shows the pretraining input pipeline for gpt2-gene-eng: DNA, protein, and natural-language sequence inputs feed a unified BPE tokenizer/encoder before the pretrained GPT-2 model.
The crop shows the XunZi-M input/fusion stage with protein-interaction and biological-process graph inputs plus multi-omics data flowing into the multimodal foundation model and GCN.
The crop visibly depicts the Shusi feature-extraction input path: amino-acid sequences and functional descriptions are encoded into embeddings before being used in the graph model.
The crop shows the TISSUENARRATOR input pipeline where a tissue patch is converted into cell sentences and then a spatial sentence that is used to fine-tune the LLM.
